origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends; its tool names, its generation settings with a dynamic thinking budget, the functionCall and functionResponse parts with the ids of the gateway), model claude-sonnet-4.5: a relay that gives every tool call the id call_0; on the third turn it stops serving the model and the native tier takes over the conversation. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
